2.text: Wars in the Eighteenth Century. — From the first years of the eigh-

3.text: teenth century we have again a series of interesting reports of Cossacks and

4.text: service-men. One of these reports, of March 14, 1710, runs as follows:¹

5.text: “In the year 1701 the tribute-men of Anadyr, the Yukaghir of the

6.text: Khodynsky clan,² Nekrasko and his kinsmen, petitioned the official of Anadyr,

7.text: the boyar-son (боярскій сынъ)³ Semen Chernyshevsky, asking him to send

8.text: service-men against the unpeaceful Chukchee of Anadyr Cape, who assaulted

9.text: them, — the Yukaghir, — in the time of reindeer-hunting, with murder and

10.text: depredation. According to that petition Semen sent the narrators — twenty-

11.text: four Russians and one hundred and ten Yukaghir and Koryak — against

12.text: the Chukchee. They left in the month of April, and were on the expedition

13.text: twenty-eight weeks. They found on the seacoast thirteen houses of the walking

14.text: (sedentary) Chukchee, and requested them to bow down under the high hand

15.text: of the great Czar and to pay tribute; but the Chukchee gave no tribute, and

16.text: retreated into their houses. The Cossacks made an attack. Ten men were

17.text: killed, and their wives and children taken captive. Many of the captives

18.text: strangled themselves and stabbed each other to death. Other Chukchee escaped,

19.text: and all of them began to gather in one place on the cape. The Cossacks

20.text: going back from the battle-place met them, about three hundred, and fought

21.text: again and killed two hundred and more. The others escaped. The next day

22.text: they met the Chukchee again in great numbers, Reindeer and walking (sedentary)

23.text: Chukchee, three thousand and more. They fought the whole day until evening,

24.text: and killed many; but the Chukchee also wounded seventy men among the

25.text: Cossacks and the tribute-paying Yukaghir. After that the Chukchee retreated

26.text: and staid not far away. The Cossacks were besieged by them for five days,

27.text: and then fled to the Anadyr.”

28.text: According to another report, the public official Ivan Lokosov, in the

29.text: year 1709, was sent against the unpeaceful Chukchee. He brought one Chukchee

30.text: man, who consented to pay tribute, also the Cossack son Ivan Ankudinov,

31.text: who was captured by the Chukchee and lived in captivity twelve years and
